subject: PHYSICS
courseName: Physics for Scientists and Engineers II

response.courseDescription: 202 Physics for Scientists and Engineers II Calculus-based physics, topics in electricity, magnetism, electromagnetics, D/C and A/C circuits, optics, reflection, refraction, interference, diffraction, polarization.
response.coursePrerequisites: 4 credits of PHYSICS 201 with a C or better, or PHYSICS 201 and 211 with a C or better, or PHYSICS 205 with a C or better; PHYSICS 212 or concurrent enrollment; MATH 172 or 182 with a C or better.
